entities.name: Dietary Laws & Food Taboos
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: Jewish kashrut laws banned pork, shellfish, and mixing meat with dairy. Hindu customs prohibited beef (cows are sacred). Islamic halal rules later mirrored many kashrut restrictions. These weren't about health — they were identity markers separating "us" from "them."
